instrument: Perseverance traverse map / HiRISE stereo DEM
title: NASA interactive rover location and traverse map
science_variables: Traverse, drive endpoints and high-resolution DEM used for rover path planning
nominal_resolution: High-resolution DEM; exact cell size not stated on page
time_coverage: Page updated 2026-10-13; traverse record shown by NASA
map_layer_id: NASA interactive map (not a direct raster download in this catalog)
caveats: Useful authoritative visual/validation reference; investigate downloadable source through Mars Trek/PDS before quantitative slope calculations.

title: Mastcam-Z science-calibrated image data
science_variables: Surface images, multispectral observations and stereo products depending on collection
spatial_scope: Along rover traverse and pointing targets
caveats: Not a continuous panorama; retain sol, camera, pointing, calibration level and local frame for each observation.

title: Mars Environmental Dynamics Analyzer observations
science_variables: Surface pressure, air/ground temperature, winds, humidity, dust and radiation-related environmental observations (product/instrument channel dependent)
spatial_scope: Point observations at rover, varying with traverse
nominal_resolution: Instrument-specific; not a gridded local map
time_coverage: Archived by PDS releases; Release 16 is latest mission-wide release as of 2026-11-14
caveats: Measurements are point/time samples at rover, not full-area values; channel definitions, units, calibration and uncertainty must be read from labels. Avoid interpolating as if directly observed.

title: Perseverance localizations, mechanism positions, ancillary and map data
science_variables: Rover position/attitude and mechanism-related localization products
caveats: Latest posted PLACES archive is not live telemetry; released archive lags operations. Read release notes and coordinate-frame documentation.

title: Jezero controlled orthoimage mosaic
science_variables: Regional surface morphology
caveats: Broad coverage suitable for regional context; not a high-resolution hazard DEM.

title: Jezero controlled orthoimage mosaic
science_variables: Visible-light surface morphology
caveats: A map mosaic, not a DEM. The stated pixel scale is not equivalent to absolute positional accuracy. Layer coverage is limited to the published bbox.

title: Mars 2020 Science Investigation CTX DEM Mosaic
science_variables: Elevation grid derived from CTX stereo; regional terrain relief
time_coverage: Merged product; PDS4 label dates are nil/inapplicable; source-image acquisition dates vary
access_type: USGS Astropedia GeoTIFF + PDS4 XML label
caveats: Downloaded locally and hash-verified. CTX stereo-derived; mosaic includes original TRN data plus Ames Stereo Pipeline extensions, vertically localised to MOLA and with horizontal georeferencing done in ArcGIS Pro. Not a current observation. Product label and catalog disagree on Mars sphere radius (3396190 vs 3396160 m); preserve native product metadata. Seam/vertical errors may affect slope locally.

title: Geologic Map of Jezero Crater and Nili Planum, SIM 3464
science_variables: Mapped geologic units and interpreted surface history
nominal_resolution: Publication scale 1:75,000; CTX base mosaic 6 m/pixel
caveats: Interpretive map units, not direct sensor measurements; use map legend and pamphlet. Public-domain USGS item.

title: Navigation camera raw image bundle
science_variables: Navigation imagery and stereo context
caveats: Raw images need labels, calibration/geometry, and coordinate registration. Avoid implying a finished 3-D surface mesh from a single image.

title: Planetary Instrument for X-ray Lithochemistry data
science_variables: Elemental composition maps of selected rock/soil targets
caveats: Not a wide-area remote map; link sample/target and exact coordinate frame.

title: Radar Imager for Mars Subsurface Exploration data
science_variables: Ground-penetrating radargrams and subsurface stratigraphy
nominal_resolution: Centimeter-scale subsurface interpretation is instrument capability; effective resolution depends on product/processing
caveats: Subsurface radar profile, not a surface hazard raster; geology interpretations require processing and context.

title: SHERLOC spectroscopy and imaging data
science_variables: Raman/fluorescence spectral observations and target images
caveats: Target-specific observations; preserve spectral processing, calibration, and association with rover localization.

title: Geometry, pointing and ancillary kernels
science_variables: Coordinate transforms, pointing, spacecraft and instrument geometry
caveats: Use matching kernel versions and documented time systems for derived locations; kernels are not terrain measurements.

title: LIBS, Raman, fluorescence, VIS/IR and RMI products
science_variables: Elemental and molecular composition of selected targets; remote sensing products
nominal_resolution: Target scale and spot size vary; see product label/instrument docs
caveats: Measurements are target-specific, not blanket regional composition. Keep method/channel and calibration level with each value.

title: Global MOLA colorized shaded relief
science_variables: Regional/global elevation and relief context
access_type: NASA Trek WMTS / ASU planetary data page
caveats: Too coarse for astronaut-scale obstacle avoidance; pair with local stereo DEM where available.

title: Jezero–NE Syrtis–Midway visible mosaic
science_variables: Regional context imagery
caveats: Composite includes multiple instruments/missions; layer listing gives no single pixel scale. Treat as visualization, not a homogeneous scientific raster.

title: Global daytime IR mosaic
science_variables: Thermal-IR radiance/brightness-temperature context (product dependent)
access_type: NASA Trek WMTS / ASU planetary data page
caveats: Thermal-IR mosaic is not a current weather forecast or direct surface-temperature time series; inspect product metadata before quantitative use.

title: Mars 2020 Terrain Relative Navigation HiRISE DTM Mosaic
science_variables: High-resolution stereo-derived elevation model
spatial_scope: Jezero landing / initial exploration area; narrower than whole-crater CTX mosaic
time_coverage: Source image products vary; data release 2020
caveats: Not downloaded (1.8 GB). Derived from HiRISE stereo; MOLA control. High detail, but spatially limited; verify exact footprint, alignment and vertical accuracy in product label before using with CTX.

title: Mars Sample Return Terrain Relative Navigation HiRISE DTM and Orthoimage Mosaics
science_variables: High-resolution stereo DEM, orthoimage and confidence mosaics
caveats: Not downloaded (5.3 GB). Extends beyond earlier DEM coverage westward. Internal HiRISE alignment is strong, but published evaluation warns HiRISE-to-CTX alignment misses its requirement; alignment is <6 m at 93rd percentile and <10.2 m at 99th percentile, so do not seamlessly merge with CTX without registration/uncertainty handling.

title: Mars Express regional color context mosaic
science_variables: Regional color/terrain context
nominal_resolution: Not stated in NASA location-map description
map_layer_id: Part of NASA location-map broader color base
access_type: NASA Science web map / ESA source imagery
caveats: ESA mission, not a NASA mission. Clearly label the attribution and do not count it as the required multiple-NASA-mission component.

title: MOLA Precision Experiment Data Record (PEDR) altimetry points
science_variables: Laser-altimetry elevation measurements
nominal_resolution: Individual altimetry footprints; not a continuous local grid
access_type: PDS ODE REST/API and downloadable products
caveats: Track sampling is sparse relative to rover-scale navigation; do not treat as continuous terrain surface.

title: TES derived thermal inertia map products
science_variables: Thermal inertia derived from TES thermal bolometer observations
nominal_resolution: Product-dependent; map products are km-scale (e.g., 8 ppd ≈ 7.5 km)
caveats: Derived thermophysical map, not instantaneous surface temperature or current weather; too coarse for small route hazards.

title: Compact Reconnaissance Imaging Spectrometer for Mars orbital products
science_variables: VNIR and IR spectra; mineralogical indicators in targeted orbital observations
spatial_scope: Orbital targeted footprints; must check ODE footprint overlap with pilot region
coverage_bbox_lonlat: Query by Jezero bbox in ODE
map_layer_id: CRISM PDS datasets / ODE product search
caveats: Targeted footprints and processing levels vary. Only include products whose footprint intersects the chosen Jezero map extent; spectral detections are interpreted mineralogy, not direct route safety.

title: Jezero preliminary block-adjusted mosaic
science_variables: Regional surface morphology
caveats: Preliminary layer; do not mix with controlled mosaic without documenting registration and version differences.

title: MCS atmospheric profile products
science_variables: Vertical temperature/dust/ice-cloud context from orbital limb sounding
spatial_scope: Orbital footprints and profiles; inspect ODE intersection
coverage_bbox_lonlat: Query by Jezero area and date in ODE
caveats: Orbital profile sampling is not a continuous ground-level local weather station. Pair with MEDA and keep vertical/temporal metadata.

title: SHARAD 3-D radar sounding volume products
science_variables: Subsurface radar sounding / structural context
spatial_scope: Regional orbital tracks/volumes; overlap must be queried
coverage_bbox_lonlat: Query by Jezero footprint in ODE/PDS
caveats: Subsurface science layer, not surface navigation hazards. Check footprint, radargram processing and depth-conversion assumptions.

title: Radiation Assessment Detector surface radiation observations
science_variables: Energetic particle and radiation environment measurements at Gale Crater
spatial_scope: Gale Crater only; analog for surface-radiation science
caveats: Do not map Gale measurements as if observed in Jezero. Use only as comparative environmental context/model input, with transfer uncertainty.

title: Global nighttime IR mosaic
science_variables: Nighttime thermal-IR context / derived thermal properties (product dependent)
caveats: Use the ASU THEMIS Global Data Sets/PDS archive to identify the exact current nighttime product; no layer ID has been verified here. Not a local hazard sensor.
